verdict.rationale: First-party docs show the agent takes plain-language instructions and autonomously edits code. The Editor offers 'natural language code commands', and 'Tell your agents what you need, and they'll work on getting it done'. Planning Mode produces implementation plans and code diffs, and Projects can span multiple folders to give the agent full codebase context. However, multi-file implementation and bug fixing are only implied, not explicitly documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of coordinated edits across multiple files, explicit bug-fix workflow from a plain-language bug description, independent hands-on corroboration of multi-file feature implementation quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can describe a feature or bug in plain language and have the agent implement or fix it across multiple files

citations.quote: Edit, orchestrate, and build all in natural language. Tell your agents what you need, and they’ll work on getting it done.
Google Antigravity's Editor view offers tab autocompletion, natural language code commands
Build AI agents that autonomously read files, run commands, edit code, and more.
Planning Mode: The agent plans thoroughly before executing tasks... produces structured implementation plans called Artifacts
Artifacts include rich markdown plans (Implementation Plans), code diffs, architecture diagrams, images, and browser recordings.
a project can work with one folder or multiple folders (e.g., a frontend and a backend repo), providing your agents with all of the context required for your codebase
